open-pdf-get-page-count.title: Open PDF and Retrieve Page Count
open-pdf-get-page-count.description: Shows how to open a PDF file from disk using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and obtain the total number of pages.

open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.title: Open PDF from FileStream and Save Copy
open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.description: Shows how to open a PDF document using a FileStream and then save it to a new file with the default Aspose.Pdf settings.

open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.title: Open Encrypted PDF Without Providing a Password
open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.description: Demonstrates how to attempt opening a password‑protected PDF using Aspose.Pdf and catch the InvalidPasswordException when no password is supplied.

save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.title: Save PDF to MemoryStream and Write to File
save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saving it into a MemoryStream, and then writing the stream to a physical file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b with Metadata Preservation
convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, converting it to PDF/A-1b compliance while preserving metadata, and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X-3 while Preserving Color Profiles
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/X-3 compliance (which retains embedded ICC color profiles), and save the resulting document.

encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner and User Passwords and Restrict Printing
encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption using user and owner passwords, and limit printing by setting specific permissions.

decrypt-encrypted-pdf.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF with User Password
decrypt-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a password‑protected PDF, decrypting it, and saving an unprotected copy using Aspose.Pdf.

add-blank-page-to-pdf.title: Add Blank Page to PDF
add-blank-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert an empty page at the end, and save the modified document.

insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.title: Insert PDF Page into Another PDF
insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF documents, selecting a page from the source PDF, inserting it into a specific position of the target PDF using Pages.Insert, and saving the merged result.

remove-third-page-from-pdf.title: Remove Third Page from PDF
remove-third-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete the third page, and save the resulting document.

split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.title: Split Multi-Page PDF into Single-Page Files
split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.description: Shows how to load a multi-page PDF and split it into separate one-page PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and page collection.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A‑1b
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, convert each to PDF/A‑1b compliance with Aspose.Pdf, and save the converted files to an output directory.

encrypt-pdf-stream.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with Passwords
encrypt-pdf-stream.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a stream, apply password protection with specific permissions using AES‑256 encryption, and write the secured PDF back to an output stream.

create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.title: Create PDF/X‑3 Document with Three Pages
create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.description: Shows how to create a new PDF, add three blank pages, convert it to PDF/X‑3 compliance, and save the resulting file.

update-pdf-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Title Metadata from Byte Array
update-pdf-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array, changing its title metadata, and saving the modified document to disk using Aspose.Pdf.

disable-font-embedding-when-saving-pdf.title: Disable Font Embedding When Saving PDF
disable-font-embedding-when-saving-pdf.description: The example opens an existing PDF, sets a default font in PdfSaveOptions to substitute missing fonts (preventing font embedding), and saves the document with the custom options.

incremental-append-page-to-pdf.title: Incrementally Append a Page to an Existing PDF
incremental-append-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF with read/write access and save it incrementally, preserving the original content while adding a new blank page with text.

compress-pdf-default-settings.title: Compress PDF with Default Settings using Aspose.Pdf
compress-pdf-default-settings.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, saving it with Aspose.Pdf's default compression, and comparing the file size before and after compression.

export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.title: Export PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.description: Shows how to split a PDF into individual page PDFs by iterating through each page with Aspose.Pdf and saving each page as its own document.

load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.title: Load PDF from MemoryStream, Change Version to 1.4, and Save
load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, converting it to PDF version 1.4 using the Convert method, and saving the result to the file system.

encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Form Filling Permission Only
encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, allowing only form filling and disabling content extraction by setting appropriate permissions.

create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.title: Create PDF/A-1b Document with Text Paragraph
create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.description: Creates a new PDF, adds a text paragraph to the first page, converts the document to PDF/A‑1b compliance, and saves the result.

rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Second PDF Page 90 Degrees
rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate the second page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

update-pdf-author-metadata.title: Update PDF Author Metadata with Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-author-metadata.description: Shows how to open a PDF using a FileInfo object, modify its Author metadata, and save the changes back to the original file.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs in a Directory
batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt all PDF files in a folder using a common user and owner password, applying specific permissions and saving the encrypted copies to a separate directory.

batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.title: Batch Decrypt Encrypted PDFs with Owner Password
batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of encrypted PDF files, open each using a shared owner password, remove the encryption, and save an unprotected copy.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b preserving structure
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring PDF/A‑1b conversion options, performing the conversion, and saving the resulting PDF/A‑1b file.

compress-pdf-high-optimization.title: Compress PDF with High Optimization and Compare File Size
compress-pdf-high-optimization.description: Loads a PDF, applies high‑level compression using Aspose.Pdf optimization options, saves the result, and prints the original and optimized file sizes.

download-pdf-from-url-and-save.title: Download PDF from URL and Save Locally with Aspose.Pdf
download-pdf-from-url-and-save.description: Demonstrates downloading a PDF via HttpClient, loading it into an Aspose.Pdf Document from a stream, and saving it to a local file.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and No Printing Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.description: Demonstrates how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set no permissions (disabling printing), and verify the encryption status.

update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.title: Update PDF Version to 1.5 with Incremental Save
update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.description: Loads a PDF, converts it to PDF version 1.5 using Document.Convert, and saves it back with incremental update enabled.

update-pdf-passwords.title: Update Passwords of an Encrypted PDF
update-pdf-passwords.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF using the owner password, change its user and owner passwords, and save the PDF with the new credentials.

split-pdf-at-page-10.title: Split PDF into Two Parts at Page 10
split-pdf-at-page-10.description: Shows how to split a PDF document into two separate files at page ten using Aspose.Pdf, with descriptive output filenames.

set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.title: Set PDF Document Title and Verify It
set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set its document title property, save the file, and then read back the title to confirm the change.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X-3 with CMYK Color Space
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to PDF/X-3 compliance while forcing all colors to CMYK using an ICC profile with Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A-1b with CSV Report
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.description: Processes all PDF files in a folder, converts each to PDF/A‑1b using Aspose.Pdf, writes individual conversion logs, and records the results in a CSV report.

rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.title: Rotate PDF Page 3 by 180 Degrees
rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF (or from a byte array), rotate the third page 180°, and save the modified document.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by applying a user password (leaving the owner password empty) and limiting permissions to viewing/printing.

encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.title: Encrypt PDF Allowing Only Form Filling
encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.description: The example loads a PDF, encrypts it with AES‑256, and sets permissions so that only form filling is allowed, then saves the protected file.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Individual Pages and Save to Separate Folders
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract each page into its own Document, and save each page as a separate PDF file inside a dedicated folder.

update-pdf-author-metadata__v2.title: Update PDF Author Metadata
update-pdf-author-metadata__v2.description: Loads a PDF file, replaces its Author metadata with the current user name, and saves the updated document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit RC4 and Verify Size Increase
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using 128‑bit RC4 encryption with Aspose.Pdf and compare the original and encrypted file sizes.

batch-encrypt-pdfs.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with User Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs.description: Demonstrates reading a JSON configuration, encrypting multiple PDF files with individual user passwords and a common owner password using Aspose.Pdf, and logging the outcomes.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X‑3 Preserving ICC Profile
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, converting it to PDF/X‑3 format while keeping the existing ICC color profile, and saving the result.

batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A‑1b with Compression and Report
batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.description: Loads each PDF from a folder, converts it to PDF/A‑1b using high compression, saves the converted file, and generates a CSV summary report with file sizes and conversion status.

add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata to PDF
add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a custom XMP metadata packet, attach it to the document using Aspose.Pdf, and save the file while preserving the new metadata.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password Only
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by applying only an owner password, giving the owner full access and restricting all user permissions.

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.title: Rotate All PDF Pages by 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each page 180°, and save the modified document.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Verify Print Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.description: The example loads a PDF, applies AES‑128 encryption with user and owner passwords, sets printing and high‑quality printing permissions, saves the encrypted file, and then opens it to verify the applied permissions.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b__v2.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑1b Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b__v2.description: Loads a PDF file, converts it to PDF/A‑1b compliance while logging conversion errors, and saves the compliant document.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Deterministic Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files in a folder using Aspose.Pdf, generating a unique password for each file from its name and logging the passwords securely.

batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.title: Batch Split PDF into Sections by Page Ranges
batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.description: Shows how to read page range definitions from a configuration file and split a PDF into separate documents using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.title: Encrypt PDF and Allow Only Form Filling
encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with user and owner passwords, restrict permissions to form filling only, and disable printing using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.title: Set PDF Document Metadata (Author, Title, Subject)
set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.description: This example shows how to open an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set its document information such as Author, Title, and Subject, save the changes, and then verify the metadata by reloading the file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Restrict Copy Permission
encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using the RC4 128‑bit algorithm with Aspose.Pdf, set permissions to allow only printing (disabling copy), and programmatically verify the applied security settings.
